allowed_observations: read-only adapter surface content hash comparison
forbidden_actions: git add, commit, checkout, reset, clean, merge, rebase, or stash in target repository
editing target repository settings before explicit enablement

phases.name: Repository structure alignment
phases.description: Check repository layout against Workspace_GC workspace rules before any repository-specific interpretation.

phases.name: Repository specification alignment
phases.description: Read repository-local specifications and compare them with Workspace_GC rule expectations.

phases.name: Level map review
phases.description: Map documentation, source, modules, implementation, discrepancies, and installation surfaces before proposing changes.

phases.name: Documentation-level discrepancy report
phases.description: Determine and report content discrepancies on the documentation level only.

phases.name: Documentation-level change request intake
phases.description: Pick up explicitly approved documentation-level change requests after discrepancy review.

phases.name: Later source/module/implementation/install planning
phases.description: Defer source, modules, implementation, and installation changes until documentation-level findings are reviewed.

phases.name: Analyze concrete change request
phases.description: Classify the request as functional requirement change, implementation detail change, rule change, JSON structure change, runtime logging change, or similar.

phases.name: Determine impact
phases.description: Identify affected documentation, source, modules, implementation, generated artifacts, install behavior, tests, and governance rules.

phases.name: Propose documentation changes
phases.description: Propose the documentation updates required to make the changed requirement or implementation detail explicit.

phases.name: Propose code changes
phases.description: Propose code, module, script, schema, or installer changes only after documentation impact is understood.

phases.name: Apply approved documentation changes
phases.description: Documentation may be changed after explicit approval because the flow is bottom-up and documentation must follow the changed requirement.

phases.name: Apply approved code changes
phases.description: Code changes may be applied only after documentation proposal review and explicit approval.
